title: CR-PAY-046 — WO delete + payments
preconds: Permissions (counted): Work Orders V+E+D + Invoicing V+E. Auto-gate forced ON (not counted): See Fin. View Mode: Full unless noted. All other permissions OFF.
steps:
1. Create a custom role with the permissions listed in Preconditions; leave all others OFF.
  2. Assign the role to a test user and log in.
  3. Exercise each capability in Expected Result and confirm it succeeds (and that gated pricing is hidden where noted).
expected:
User CAN: See WOs; create/edit WOs; delete WOs; reverse invoices (no payments); create invoices; process payments; deposits; send to terminal

Risk / Rationale: Positive capability check — confirms this combination grants exactly the listed actions and nothing gated leaks. See Flag / Note.
Spec Ref: §1a+§1h
Flag / Note: \u26a0 reverse via WO Delete; deleting payments still needs Invoicing Delete
